content.content: 1. Necessity: the refusal needs the log decision for the set read it completes, and the store's failure shape for the reason it names — without either, refusing is motiveless. Fail if an edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts a prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Log's all-or-nothing read is where D16b meets the store's failure shape; the gate keeps the use sound without testing the refusal itself.
